prompt:
Create transparent-background pixel-art atlas with exactly TWO equal square cells side by side, TOP then BOTTOM, of the same narrow alley barricade with barrel and traffic cone in canonical source. The labeled source and accepted FRONT/RIGHT/LEFT/REAR are authoritative for identity, scale, and orientation; ignore incorrect old plan views which show an upright board face. True orthographic projections, straight down for TOP and straight up from below for BOTTOM, no perspective/isometric.

TOP: show the two pale stone post cap footprints at the barricade ends, the crossed/planked wooden barricade as thin low horizontal board strips between them, plus the separate barrel lid and traffic cone tip/circular upper cap projecting in front of the barricade on the same side and at their source locations. Keep the barrel/cone overhang outside the post footprints; do not flatten the full frontal crossed-board face into a large square panel.
BOTTOM: show compact matching post-foot undersides, underside of the thin wooden cross planks/bracing, full barrel base and traffic cone base footprints in correct positions; no upright crossed-board face. Maintain the complete shared XY footprint including barrel/cone offset and shallow barricade depth. Preserve warm brown wood, pale stone, blue-brown barrel, orange-white cone, subtle grass. Center both, transparent margin, no labels, shadow, guide marks or clipping; crisp pixel-art clusters.
